About Prairie Peak

A disciplined approach
to self-storage investing

Prairie Peak Investments is a private investment firm focused on acquiring mismanaged, single-story self-storage facilities in carefully selected, undersupplied micromarkets across the U.S. We target opportunities where operational improvements and market fundamentals combine to drive superior risk-adjusted returns for our investors.

Our Approach

Where we invest

We focus exclusively on value-add single-story self-storage — a resilient asset class with durable demand fundamentals. Our edge is identifying mismanaged properties in micromarkets where supply constraints and growing demand create compelling value-add potential.

  • Property Type
    Single-Story Self-Storage
    Focused on operational value-add opportunities; drive-up, non-climate and climate controlled, boat/RV, and warehouse units
  • Property Size
    30,000+ NRSF
    Minimum net rentable square footage threshold ensuring institutional-quality scale and operational efficiency
  • Target Regions
    Southeast · Midwest · Mountain West
    Select secondary and tertiary markets characterized by supply constraints, growing populations, and limited institutional competition
The Team

Principals with proven
self‑storage expertise

The Prairie Peak principals spent numerous years working closely together and bring over 20 years of combined experience in self-storage investing — spanning acquisitions, asset management, and capital formation.

Jack
Principal

An 11+ year veteran in commercial and residential acquisitions specializing in self-storage, Jack’s industry relationships are key to securing consistent off-market deal flow. He spent the first decade of his career at Blue Vista Capital Management, where he co-led self-storage investment activity, evaluating over 600 transactions totaling more than $6B in capitalization and closing 27 deals across 2.4M SF and $335M. Jack also worked at Blue Owl Capital on one of the firm’s highest-profile data center projects. A University of Wisconsin graduate, Jack resides in Chicago with his wife, son, and dog.

Ben
Principal

A seasoned real estate investment expert with 9+ years of experience evaluating residential and self-storage acquisitions, Ben has overseen the acquisition and development of over $600M in total capitalization of residential investments and asset managed over 2,000 units of multifamily assets nationwide through lease-up, loan workout, and other complex situations. Prior to founding Prairie Peak, Ben worked at Blue Vista Capital Management, Cadre, and Acre Valley Real Estate Capital. He lives in Chicago with his wife and dog, and is deeply invested in University of Michigan Athletics.
